annotations.title: When will it happen (marriage, job, money, child, house)

description: Finds the good time windows in the next years for one life area — marriage, career/job, wealth, children, property/house, education or health — from the birth chart with VedicDost's software: the chart's promise for that house, supportive Vimshottari dasha periods and Jupiter–Saturn transits, plus a year-by-year view. Gives windows (months), not exact dates. Use for "when will I get married", "when will I get a job", "shaadi kab hogi".

language.description: User language: hi, en, mr, gu, bn, ta, te or kn (default en). Text and links come in this language.

place.description: Birth place: an Indian city ("Satna") or "City, Country" anywhere ("London, United Kingdom")

time.description: Birth time HH:MM, 24-hour local clock time (optional; without it Lagna and houses are skipped)

timezone.description: Optional IANA zone (e.g. Asia/Kolkata); found from the place if left out
